name: Filter pump bass
desc: French-touch bassline in F minor: driving 8ths on F-Db-Eb-C with a deep sidechain-feel saw pump, 24db filter breathing over 16 cycles, octave gallop appearing at peak. Roule-label low end - fat, filtered, relentless.

pump.doc: pump floor as fraction of gain (lower = deeper duck)

code.full: note("<[f1 f1 f1 f1 f1 f1 ab1 g1]*1 [db1 db1 db1 db1 db1 db1 f1 eb1]*1 [eb1 eb1 eb1 eb1 eb1 eb1 g1 f1]*1 [c1 c1 c1 c1 c1 c1 eb1 d1]*1>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype("24db").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(5).attack(.004).decay(.16).sustain(.14).release(.04).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.06).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[f1 f2 f1 f2 f1 f2 [ab1 g1] [f1 f2]] [db1 db2 db1 db2 db1 db2 [f1 eb1] [db1 db2]] [eb1 eb2 eb1 eb2 eb1 eb2 [g1 f1] [eb1 eb2]] [c1 c2 c1 c2 c1 c2 [eb1 d1] [c2 g1]]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype("24db").lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*2).slow(8)).lpq(6).attack(.003).decay(.13).sustain(.1).release(.03).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.06).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(3).play()
